mary.name: Mary Lennox
mary.role: The girl who finds the garden
mary.note: Mary comes from India after losing her parents. At first she is cross, lonely and “quite contrary”. Caring for the garden — and for her new friends — slowly changes her.
mary.quote: Might I have a bit of earth?

colin.name: Colin Craven
colin.role: The boy in the hidden room
colin.note: Colin is Mr. Craven's son. He has spent his life in bed, afraid he will never get well. When someone finally listens to him, he finds the courage to go outside.
colin.quote: I am going to live forever and ever and ever!

dickon.name: Dickon Sowerby
dickon.note: Dickon is Martha's brother. He lives on the moor and can calm any animal. He is patient and gentle, and he knows how to help living things grow.

martha.name: Martha Sowerby
martha.note: Martha is cheerful and kind. She is the first person at the manor who treats Mary as a friend.

ben.name: Ben Weatherstaff
ben.note: Ben is grumpy on the outside, but he loved Mrs. Craven's garden and secretly kept caring for it.
